title: Existence of normalized local operations and tensor comparisons
statement: Fix schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X to Y, coefficient ring sheaves RY,RX on their pro-etale sites, and an isomorphism c:f-inverse RY isomorphic to RX. For every normalized global datum g and object V of Y-pro-etale, Local(f,RY,RX,c,g,V), as defined in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data], is nonempty. Thus the exact restrictions, actual localized module operation, normalized tensor models and comparisons with their shifts, normalized derived direct-image and pullback square, and counit-mate equation exist. This asserts no ProjectionCompatible condition.

theorem localData_exists
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_X)
    (g : Global f R_Y R_X c) (V : Y.ProEt) :
    Nonempty (Local f R_Y R_X c g V)
